name: hero-video
description: The hero video on the aws-analyzer home page

scripts.figures: mkdir -p public/figures public/aws && cp ../docs/images/aws/*.svg public/aws/ && for f in overview dynamodb-table-info kb-explorer-failed sagemaker-instance opensearch-index-info lambda-functions sfn-explorer-graph apigw-explorer; do cp ../docs/images/$f-dark.webp public/figures/; done
scripts.render: npm run figures && remotion render HeroDemo ../docs/images/hero-demo.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=30 --x264-preset=slower && remotion still HeroDemo ../docs/images/hero-poster.webp --frame=-1
